select buss_number,contract_Code , dis_code , "type" , sum(need_num) need_num , sum(sum(task_num)) over ( partition by buss_number ,contract_Code,dis_code ) task_num , max(create_time) create_time , max(id) id , max(primary_key) primary_key ,STRING_AGG(array_to_string(ARRAY_AGG(primary_key), ','),',' ) over ( partition by buss_number,contract_Code ,dis_code ) primary_keys ,sum(sum(need_num)) over ( partition by buss_number,contract_Code ,dis_code ) sum_Need_Num from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.disCountOptimal} a where data_source = 'process' and need_num > 0
and enterprise_code= ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and delete_flag=false
and exists ( select 1 from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPartProcedure} b where a.dis_code=b.primary_key and b.product_part_procedure_sign like '%'||#{data.searchName}||'%' )
and buss_number like '%'||#{data.bussNumber}||'%'
and type='stock'
and type='purchase'
and type='process'
and type='produce'
and ( 1!=1 or exists( select 1 from ( select aa.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (partition by buss_number ,procedure_code order by last_time desc NULLS last ) id, case when status=50 then 1 when finish_num>0 then 2 when allocation_num>0 then 3 else 4 end status_code,
case when status=50 then procedure_name||'已完成' when finish_num>0 then procedure_name||'生产中' when allocation_num>0 then procedure_name||'待生产' else procedure_name||'待安排' end status_name
from ( select m.buss_number,m.procedure_code , max( m.status) status, d."operator" , max(r.creator) creator, max(d.produce_time ) produce_time,max(r.report_date) report_date,max(d.create_time ) create_time, sum(d.allocation_num) allocation_num ,max( m.procedure_name) procedure_name,sum(r.finish_num) finish_num,sum(scrap_num) scrap_num, GREATEST(max(d.produce_time ) , max(r.report_date) ,max(d.create_time ) ,max(m.create_time )) last_time
from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.produceMain} m left join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.produceSubDispatcher} d on m.primary_key =d.main_id left join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.produceSubReport} r on r.main_id = m.primary_key and d."operator" =r.creator where m.procedure_flag = 1 and m.enterprise_code= ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} group by m.buss_number,m.procedure_code,m.status ,d."operator" order by produce_time desc NULLS last ) as aa
) as aa where aa.id =1 and a.type='produce' and aa.buss_number =a.buss_number and aa.procedure_code=a.dis_code and aa.status_code in
#{id}
)

select state_After_Op status_Code, latest_op_staff person_Code, latest_Op_Time last_Time from (select aa.*, ROW_NUMBER() over(order by latest_Op_Time desc nulls last) id from (select ab.contract_Code, ab.produce_code, ab.state_After_Op, ab.latest_Op_Time, ab.latest_op_staff from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.latestLackPurchaseState} ab where ab.contract_Code = a.contract_Code and ab.produce_code = a.dis_code and ab.enterprise_code= ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} union all select a.contract_Code, a.dis_code, 40, a.create_time, a.person_code ) aa) aa where aa.id = 1 and a.type='process' and aa.state_After_Op in
#{id}
)
)
group by buss_number, contract_Code, dis_code, "type" order by create_time desc, id desc

select * from (select d.primary_key key, max(d.create_time) create_time, max(p.operation_time) operation_time, sum(d.apply_num) apply_num , sum(p.operation_num) operation_num, GREATEST(max(d.create_time), max(p.operation_time)) last_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( order by GREATEST( max(d.create_time),max(p.operation_time) ) desc NULLS last ) id
, case when GREATEST(max(d.create_time), max(p.operation_time)) = max(d.create_time) then 357345743574663168 when sum(d.apply_num) > sum(p.operation_num) then 357345966313177088 else 357346032495099904 end status_code
from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outboundOrder} o join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outboundOrderDetail} b on o.primary_key = b.outbound_order join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outboundApplyDetail} d on d.primary_key = any (b.apply_details) left join (select p.apply_detail_code, sum(operation_num) operation_num, max(operation_time) operation_time from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.positionOperation} p group by p.apply_detail_code) p on d.primary_key = p.apply_detail_code where d.remark like '%库存%' and o.contract_number = #{bus} and b.product_or_part = #{partCode} and o.enterprise_code= ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} group by d.primary_key) d where id = 1

select b.outbound_status status_code , p.operation_time , p.operation_num , p.operator operator , c.product_part_sign productName , c.model model , c.unity_no unity_no from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outboundOrder} o join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outboundOrderDetail} b on o.primary_key = b.outbound_order join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productPart} c on c.primary_key = b.product_or_part join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.outboundApplyDetail} d on d.primary_key = any (b.apply_details) join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.positionOperation} p on p.apply_detail_code = d.primary_key where o.contract_number = #{bus} and d.remark like '%库存%' and o.enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} and b.product_or_part = #{partCode} order by p.operation_time

select * from (select aa.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (partition by buss_number ,product_or_part order by last_time desc NULLS last ) id, case when status = 50 then 1 when finish_num > 0 then 2 when allocation_num > 0 then 3 else 4 end status_code,
case when status = 50 then case when ${dynamicTableNameProxy.isRoute()} then procedure_name else '' end || '生产已完成' when finish_num > 0 then case when ${dynamicTableNameProxy.isRoute()} then procedure_name else '' end || '生产中' when allocation_num > 0 then case when ${dynamicTableNameProxy.isRoute()} then procedure_name else '' end || '待生产' else case when ${dynamicTableNameProxy.isRoute()} then procedure_name else '' end || '待安排' end status_name

from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.produceMain} m left join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.produceSubDispatcher} d on m.primary_key = d.main_id left join ${dynamicTableNameProxy.produceSubReport} r on r.main_id = m.primary_key and d."operator" = r.creator
where m.procedure_flag = 1 and m.enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} group by m.buss_number, m.product_or_part, m.status, d."operator" order by produce_time desc NULLS last) as aa) as aa where aa.id = 1 and aa.buss_number = #{id} and aa.product_or_part = #{partCode}
